body.en: Chinese regulators blocked the reported deal for Meta to acquire Manus, halting what would have been a major acquisition of Xiao Hong's company.
body.zh: 中国监管部门阻止了Meta据报准备收购Manus的交易，使这一原本可能成为肖弘公司重大并购案的计划搁浅。

body.en: Meta agreed to acquire Manus (Butterfly Effect) for billions of dollars, and founder Xiao Hong will become a Meta Vice President.
body.zh: Meta同意以数十亿美元收购Manus（蝴蝶效应），创始人肖弘将出任Meta副总裁。

body.en: A profile of Xiao Hong published as Meta acquires Manus for $2 billion, the deal that moved his company under Meta.
body.zh: 在 Meta 以 20 亿美元收购 Manus 之际发布的肖弘人物报道，这笔交易使他的公司归入 Meta。

body.en: Meta's reported $2 billion acquisition of Manus fell through, and founder Xiao Hong was found to be linked to two other active companies.
body.zh: Meta拟20亿美元收购Manus一事生变，创始人肖弘被曝关联另外两家存续企业。

title.en: Meta acquires Manus for US$2 billion, who is Xiao Hong?

body.en: Meta acquired Manus, the company Xiao Hong founded, for about $2 billion.
